name: resurge-website
description: Website for Resurge, the free, open-source AI health coach for Android.

scripts.og: "/Applications/Google Chrome.app/Contents/MacOS/Google Chrome" --headless=new --hide-scrollbars --force-device-scale-factor=1 --window-size=1200,630 --virtual-time-budget=3000 --allow-file-access-from-files --screenshot=/tmp/resurge-og.png "file://$PWD/og/og.html" && sips -s format jpeg -s formatOptions 88 /tmp/resurge-og.png --out public/og.jpg
